notes.why: A well-fed plasmodium moves away from light and a starved one toward it. The whole field could lean away from or toward the brightest region. Not drawn.

rows: A slime mould is one huge cell, from a kingdom apart from the fungi. It has no eye, and it reads how much light falls on it and of what colour.
Physarum polycephalum crawls away from blue light and far-red light, and toward red light.
Well fed, it moves away from light. Short of food, it moves toward light, and after several days without food, light turns it into spore heads.
It stretches tubes between pieces of food and finds the shortest route between them through a maze. The picture has no sense of food.
Its body swells and thins every one to two minutes, and its speed rises and falls over about 20 minutes. Your eyes follow flicker to about 60 a second.
Green is removed and changes are averaged over about 6 seconds. Both choices are the app's own.
